description: LiveRamp ATS Envelope refresh on api.rlcdn.com/api/identity/v2/envelope/refresh. pid, envelope type it, and envelope value iv are required. Retrieve is vendor/liveramp-envelope. Cookie sync stays directory-only.

params.name: pid
params.description: It is the LiveRamp Placement ID.
params.fix_hint: Send `pid` with the Placement ID LiveRamp issued for this property.

params.name: it
params.description: It is the envelope type. LiveRamp documents `19` ATS envelopes and `24` Meta-scoped envelopes. Retrieve uses identifier types 4, 11, and 15 instead.
params.fix_hint: Send `it=19` for an ATS envelope, or `it=24` for a Meta-scoped envelope.

params.name: iv
params.description: It is the stored envelope value, not the original hashed identifier.
params.fix_hint: Send `iv` with the envelope string returned by the retrieve call.

params.name: ct
params.description: It is the consent type. LiveRamp documents `4` TCF v2 and `3` CCPA.
params.fix_hint: Send `ct=4` with a TCF string in `cv`, or `ct=3` for CCPA.

params.name: atype
params.description: It is the implementation source. LiveRamp documents `1` ATS.js, `2` ATS API, `3` server-to-server, and `4` the mobile SDK.
params.fix_hint: Send `atype=2` from an API call, or `atype=3` from a server.
